_note: Thresholds for the delay analysis and the forecast. Re-read on every rebuild (POST /api/patterns/rebuild or a restart). Minutes everywhere.

season._note: A month is seasonal for a station when its mean added delay is this far above the station's median month.

hour._note: An hour of day is a problem window when its mean added delay (seasonal months excluded) is this far above the station's median hour.

unusual._note: Today's delay at a station is unusual when it beats the train's last-window p90 there by over_p90_min AND its median by over_median_min.

model._note: Quantile gradient boosting for arrival delay. The last test_days of history are held out to score it against the persistence baseline.
